array.string: launchctl setenv ARCUS_API_KEY "$(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -w -s 'arcus-token' -a 'devrev')" launchctl setenv DEVREV_API_KEY "$(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -w -s 'DevRev API Key' -a 'API Keys')" launchctl setenv CIRCLECI_TOKEN "$(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -w -s 'CircleCI Token' -a 'API Keys')" launchctl setenv OPENCODE_ENABLE_PARALLEL true launchctl setenv OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_FILEWATCHER true launchctl setenv OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKGROUND_SUBAGENTS true
